desc: 🎯💤 Welcome to Dart & Dash! How to play: 🎯 Aim and use a dart to put rare animals to sleep! 🏃 Bring them back before they wake up… or before they get DEVOURED! 💰 Place them in your zoo to earn money. ⚡ Train on the treadmill and unlock new courses. 🔭 Upgrade your weapon to see and hunt from further away. ✨ Discover even rarer animals and mutations: Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Void! 🏆 Collect them all in the Index! ❤️ Like the game and join the group to receive a free gift! 🎮 Playable on PC, console, mobile, and tablet
